sections.overview:
Step-up is a marketing automation skill that functions as a clone of Engage Bay, an all-in-one platform for marketing, sales, and service automation. It is designed to streamline customer relationship management (CRM) by integrating marketing, sales, and service capabilities into a unified system. This skill enables users to automate and manage their business processes across multiple departments from a single platform.
Automating email marketing campaigns and lead nurturing workflows
Managing sales pipelines and customer interactions from a centralized CRM
Coordinating customer service and support ticket management
Tracking and analyzing customer engagement across marketing channels
